parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Optional DB schema that overrides the schema specified in the connection. Make sure that if you change the schema parameter value in the constructor of the derived Hook, such change should be done before calling the ``DBApiHook.__init__()``.

parameters.name: log_sql
parameters.description: Whether to log SQL query when it's executed. Defaults to *True*.

parameters.name: source_bucket
parameters.description: Source GCS bucket that contains the csv

parameters.name: presto_table
parameters.description: presto table to upload the data

parameters.name: gcp_conn_id
parameters.description: (Optional) The connection ID used to connect to Google Cloud and interact with the Google Cloud Storage service.

parameters.name: impersonation_chain
parameters.description: Optional service account to impersonate using short-term credentials, or chained list of accounts required to get the access_token of the last account in the list, which will be impersonated in the request. If set as a string, the account must grant the originating account the Service Account Token Creator IAM role. If set as a sequence, the identities from the list must grant Service Account Token Creator IAM role to the directly preceding identity, with first account from the list granting this role to the originating account.
